users.bio: I enjoy building accessible web tools and learning from interdisciplinary teams.
I prototype small robots and want to collaborate on practical sustainability projects.
I turn research findings into clear interfaces and visual stories.
I study local ecosystems and am learning to analyze environmental data.
I like reproducible analysis and presenting results to nontechnical audiences.
I build sensor systems and write firmware for student engineering teams.
I am interested in learning experiences and thoughtful research design.
I am new to team projects and would like to practice frontend development.
My lab studies biodiversity and tools for community environmental monitoring.
I work on accessible computing and student-centered learning technology.

projects.title: Campus Accessibility Map
projects.description: Build a map of accessible campus entrances, study spaces, and routes. We need frontend developers and designers to prototype a clear mobile experience and validate it with student volunteers.

projects.title: Community Garden Sensor Network
projects.description: Prototype low-cost soil moisture sensors for the university community garden. The team will design enclosures, collect measurements, and create a simple dashboard for volunteers.

projects.title: Study Buddy Interface Research
projects.description: Explore how students find study partners across departments. Help conduct interviews and turn the findings into an accessible interactive prototype.

projects.title: Campus Biodiversity Survey
projects.description: Join a faculty-led survey of pollinators and native plants. Students will collect field observations, clean data, and help communicate seasonal changes. Training is provided for new field researchers.

projects.title: Accessible Learning Tools Evaluation
projects.description: Evaluate the accessibility of common learning tools with a faculty research group. Help design study materials, run usability sessions, and summarize findings for educators.

projects.title: Public Health Data Explorer
projects.description: Create an educational dashboard using public, aggregated health datasets. The project focuses on reproducible analysis, clear charts, and communicating uncertainty without collecting personal health information.

projects.title: Introductory Robotics Workshop
projects.description: Draft a hands-on workshop for students who have never programmed a robot. This private draft is included to test project visibility for its owner.

projects.title: Campus Repair Directory
projects.description: Build a directory of student repair clubs and local repair events. The team is implementing search and preparing a small usability study.

projects.title: Student Pollinator Field Guide
projects.description: A completed illustrated field guide to common campus pollinators, combining field observations with clear visual explanations.

projects.title: Quiet Study Spaces Pilot
projects.description: An archived pilot exploring how students describe and locate quiet study spaces. Kept as a demo of an archived project visible only to its owner or team.
